caption: The drawing features a horizontal decorative border located near the center of a vertically oriented, blank, light beige or off-white background. The border itself consists of a repeating pattern that occupies a rectangular strip, oriented horizontally. The primary colors in the border are green, yellow, brown, and gold. The upper and lower edges of the border are defined by parallel lines in brown, yellow, and gold. Within the strip, there are repeated ornamental motifs in a stylized, symmetrical design composed of rounded and angular shapes that resemble an abstract floral or bell form. These motifs are primarily yellow and gold with brown and black accents, separated from one another by small, green hanging shapes resembling stylized leaves or pendants. The background behind the motifs inside the border is a rich green color. The rest of the page outside the rectangular strip is completely empty.
title: Wallpaper Border
